entry.title: Sonix 0.3.14
entry.summary: ## Changes - **Projects are saved as one block.** A project now keeps the preset, your edits and every setting (tuning, theme, layers, voices, effects) together, and reopening it puts all of it back in one go. entry.title: Sonix 0.3.12
entry.summary: A ROMpler with 128 presets and 45 instruments - pianos, keys, guitars, strings, brass, choirs, pads, synths, leads, plucks, bass and bells, from CC0 / CC BY recordings and original renders. Four layers, filter, LFO, chorus, delay, reverb, eleven colorways. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61).
